content.thinking: Now run python3 to compute the sum and write it to sum.txt, then verify.

content.text: Now compute the sum with a python3 script:

arguments.command:
python3 -c "
nums = [int(line) for line in open('nums.txt') if line.strip()]
total = sum(nums)
open('sum.txt', 'w').write(str(total))
print('computed:', total)
" && echo '--- nums.txt ---' && cat nums.txt && echo '--- sum.txt ---' && cat sum.txt
